questions.q: When does the family make this cake?
questions.e: In the video: "Ovo je torta koja se kod nas u kući pravi kad god je nekom rođendan" — this is the cake we make at home whenever it is somebody's birthday.
In the video: "Prvo skuvam puding od vanile" — first I cook a vanilla pudding.

questions.q: Into how many parts is the cream divided?
questions.e: In the video: "podelim je u tri jednaka dela" — I divide it into three equal parts.

questions.q: What goes into the third part?
questions.e: In the video: "u treći rastopljenu crnu čokoladu" — into the third melted dark chocolate.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Onda smesu pridodam pudingu i podelim je u tri *jednaka* dela.
U prvi deo dodajem mlevenu plazmu, u drugi *krupno* mlevene lešnike.
Prvo skuvam puding od vanile, pokrijem i ostavim da se *ohladi*.
Za to vreme *penasto* umutim puter i dodam šećer u prahu.

questions.e: The preposition od ("of, from") takes the genitive: vanile.

questions.q: Onda smesu pridodam ___ i podelim je u tri jednaka dela.
questions.e: Pridodati ("to add to") takes the dative: pudingu.
Dodajem ("I add") + direct object takes the accusative: plazmu.

questions.q: Onda ređam redom prvo sloj sa ___.
questions.e: The preposition sa ("with") takes the instrumental: plazmom.
